name: expressive_acoustic
character: a solo or small acoustic performance where rubato, portamento and an unresolved appoggiatura are the expression: the contour and resolution rows still measure, and their verdict is a warning rather than a failed certification
_source: docs/DYNAMIC-GATE-PLAN.md P2; the role keys and their ranges are references/data/presets/gate/data/scene_roles.json

feel.contour.reason: measured on western_ghats_sunrise: bansuri 89% stepwise, violins_counter 86%, pipes 72%, every figure line above the 45% floor. The row is relaxed, not loosened: the 0.45 floor and the 0.25 fail floor stay where the corpus put them, and a line that falls under them is reported as a warning because a solo acoustic take adds appoggiaturas and portamento that a note-event contour reads as leaps - the player's slide up to a grace note is not a melodic leap

feel.resolution.reason: measured on indo_afro_sunrise: bansuri resolves all 24 of its tension notes under the piece's own gravity, so a line here that leaves a tension open is a choice, not a defect; on night_pursuit_cinematic the same rule leaves 8 of the horns' tension notes open and the cue is right to (the sheet's release is a cut). A warning keeps that visible without failing a performance whose whole idiom is the suspended appoggiatura

scene.macro_contrast.reason: same measurement as cinematic_suspense: indo_afro_sunrise 0.144 and western_ghats_sunrise 0.238 against night_pursuit_cinematic 0.00002, so 0.0005 separates a small acoustic set that moves from one that holds a single harmonic state for its whole length
